scope.purpose: Let the user enter one number in a form by typing it, formatted for the locale, or by stepping it with the arrow keys or two steppers.
useCases: A measure bounded by min and max.
exclusions: Currencies, units and percentages shown in the field.
Numbers beyond the precision of a double, scientific notation.
Press-and-hold repetition on the steppers (key repetition covers the keyboard).
Changing the value with the mouse wheel.
alternatives: Slider for a value picked by eye in a bounded range.
InputText for digits that are not a quantity (postal code, card number).

decisionsTaken: Values are ISO strings where a date or time is involved; @internationalized/date (a peer dependency of Bits UI) is declared as a peer dependency of the package and used internally only (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T1: "Ok pour moi, les dates font partie de ces choses difficiles à traiter sans dépendance externe").

Locale is a prop (BCP 47, default "en"), deterministic on the server; no application-wide locale provider: components are delivered as units with settings only, each project integrates its global logic (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T2).

Segment names come from Intl.DisplayNames(locale, dateTimeField) and button labels are props with English defaults, replacing the English strings hard-coded in Bits UI (contract over Bits UI; User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T3).

Invalid belongs to the application: min and max limit the controls but never set invalid by themselves (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T5).

Number props may have no default (schema change accepted by the user in User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping): value has no value until one is given, min and max are optional.

Steppers in every size, including sm (user question at the scoping: "pourquoi masquer les boutons en SM ?"): they are internal parts on size.control.nested.{size}, not IconButtons, so they fit inside an sm field; decrease at the inline start and increase at the inline end, so that their 44 px targets do not overlap; hideSteppers removes them.

Written without Bits UI (it has no number input): a text input with inputmode decimal exposed as a spin button, not input type number (wheel changes, accepts e, empties its value on invalid text, cannot be formatted).
Values clamp to min and max on commit; typed values are not snapped to step, stepping goes to the next multiple of step.
nextAction: Contract gate (wave 6, grouped): present the contract and the token additions, record the approval.
implementationNotes: Parsing and formatting through Intl.NumberFormat(locale).formatToParts to learn the grouping and decimal separators.
Decimal stepping without floating error: round to the larger number of fraction digits of the value and of step.

informational.reason: Same field colors as InputText (color.input.*): its exemption accepted at the wave 2 contract gate (2026-10-26, "4 ok") applies; color.input.default.border reaches 2.06 on surface.muted in dark, a de-emphasized backdrop where forms are not expected.
